note: Measured ceiling of the full loop, not a design choice. The generator reaches the commanded speed (reference 2.26 m/s at command 2.5) but the robot does not: achieved saturates near 1.0 m/s and the surplus appears as stance foot slip, which leaves the training corpus's band (1.4-3.9 cm/s) above command 1.6. Commanding past that asks the robot to slide.
